  WHY: The `test_claude_template_live_parity` test enforces byte-identical copies of the two hook files. The merge commit `da50a48` introduced drift between them, causing the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` CI job to fail with "1 failed, 614 passed". The CI log shows a unified diff between the two `_evaluate_mcp_push` functions. Until both copies match, the `lint` aggregate job will fail, blocking the PR.
